verdict.rationale: Adyen's own getting-paid documentation says merchants can change how they get paid for each merchant account. That is a first-party payout-configuration capability, but the single thin mention does not show payout timing visibility or accelerated next-day/instant payouts. missing for 10: visibility into when each payout lands, documented next-day or instant payout options, detail on how to speed up a payout on demand, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash

citations.quote: you have the option to change how you get paid for each of your merchant accounts
